instruction:
You are a wastewater process engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-10 aeration blower process, power, and acoustic package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. BioWin, GPS-X, SUMO, blower selection, and acoustic screening workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run those tools or parse a real process model, source pack, or vendor export.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-10-LH-02`
- Sampling table: `SAMPLE-10-AER-02`
- Process criteria: `CRITERIA-10-AER-02`
- Blower data sheet: `BLOWER-10-DATA-02`
- Motor schedule: `MOTOR-10-SCHED-02`
- Receiver plan: `RECEIVER-10-PLAN-02`
- Aeration/acoustic memo: `MEMO-10-AER-02`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Design flow | {{ flow_rate_m3_d }} m3/d |
| Influent BOD | {{ influent_bod_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Effluent BOD | {{ effluent_bod_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Influent TKN | {{ influent_tkn_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Effluent TKN | {{ effluent_tkn_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Sludge production | {{ sludge_production_kg_d }} kg/d |
| Denitrified nitrogen | {{ denitrified_nitrogen_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Field oxygen transfer efficiency | {{ field_transfer_efficiency }} |
| Air oxygen mass fraction | {{ air_oxygen_mass_fraction }} |
| Air density | {{ air_density_kg_m3 }} kg/m3 |
| Blower capacity | {{ blower_capacity_m3_min }} m3/min |
| Blower discharge pressure | {{ blower_discharge_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Blower efficiency | {{ blower_efficiency }} |
| Motor efficiency | {{ motor_efficiency }} |
| Selected motor | {{ selected_motor_kw }} kW |
| Blower sound level | {{ blower_sound_level_dba }} dBA |
| Header sound level | {{ header_sound_level_dba }} dBA |
| Enclosure sound level | {{ enclosure_sound_level_dba }} dBA |
| Receiver distance | {{ receiver_distance_m }} m |
| Receiver criterion | {{ receiver_criterion_dba }} dBA |

## Calculation Rules

- BOD removed equals `flow_rate_m3_d x (influent_bod_mg_l - effluent_bod_mg_l) / 1000`.
- Nitrogen removed equals `flow_rate_m3_d x (influent_tkn_mg_l - effluent_tkn_mg_l) / 1000`.
- Oxygen demand equals `max(bod_removed - 1.42 x sludge_production + 4.57 x nitrogen_removed - 2.86 x denitrified_nitrogen, 0)`.
- Required airflow uses `air_oxygen_mass_fraction x air_density_kg_m3 x field_transfer_efficiency`.
- Blower input power equals `(required_airflow_m3_min / 60) x blower_discharge_pressure_kpa / blower_efficiency / motor_efficiency`.
- Combine source sound levels with logarithmic summation, then subtract `20 x log10(receiver_distance_m)` at the receiver.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when blower oxygen capacity, motor margin, and acoustic margin are non-negative.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated BioWin/GPS-X/SUMO evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "bod_removed_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "nitrogen_removed_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "oxygen_demand_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "required_airflow_m3_min": <numeric_value>,
  "blower_oxygen_capacity_margin_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "blower_input_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "motor_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "combined_source_spl_dba": <numeric_value>,
  "receiver_spl_dba": <numeric_value>,
  "acoustic_margin_db": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-10 aeration blower process, power, and acoustic template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one sampling, blower, motor, receiver, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "aeration-blower-process-power-acoustic-package"
description = "SSC-10 aeration blower process, power, and acoustic metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound aeration blower metrics from a deterministic SSC-10 task-owned source pack. The template combines organic and nitrogen load, oxygen demand, airflow, blower input power, motor margin, receiver sound level, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "aeration-blower-acoustic"
standards = ["BioWin", "GPS-X", "SUMO", "blower selection workflow", "acoustic receiver screening"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "aeration", "blower", "oxygen", "motor", "acoustic", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.flow_rate_m3_d]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/d"
description = "SAMPLE-10-AER-02 design flow"
min = 6200.0
max = 6200.0

[params.influent_bod_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "SAMPLE-10-AER-02 influent BOD"
min = 250.0
max = 250.0

[params.effluent_bod_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "CRITERIA-10-AER-02 effluent BOD"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.influent_tkn_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "SAMPLE-10-AER-02 influent TKN"
min = 45.0
max = 45.0

[params.effluent_tkn_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "CRITERIA-10-AER-02 effluent TKN"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.sludge_production_kg_d]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/d"
description = "CRITERIA-10-AER-02 sludge production credit"
min = 760.0
max = 760.0

[params.denitrified_nitrogen_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "CRITERIA-10-AER-02 denitrified nitrogen"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.field_transfer_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 field oxygen transfer efficiency"
min = 0.17
max = 0.17

[params.air_oxygen_mass_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 oxygen mass fraction in air"
min = 0.23
max = 0.23

[params.air_density_kg_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/m3"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 air density"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.blower_capacity_m3_min]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/min"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 selected blower capacity"
min = 58.0
max = 58.0

[params.blower_discharge_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 discharge pressure"
min = 68.0
max = 68.0

[params.blower_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 blower efficiency"
min = 0.69
max = 0.69

[params.motor_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "MOTOR-10-SCHED-02 motor efficiency"
min = 0.94
max = 0.94

[params.selected_motor_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "MOTOR-10-SCHED-02 selected motor rating"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.blower_sound_level_dba]
type = "float"
unit = "dBA"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 blower sound level"
min = 82.0
max = 82.0

[params.header_sound_level_dba]
type = "float"
unit = "dBA"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 header sound level"
min = 79.0
max = 79.0

[params.enclosure_sound_level_dba]
type = "float"
unit = "dBA"
description = "BLOWER-10-DATA-02 enclosure sound level"
min = 76.0
max = 76.0

[params.receiver_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "RECEIVER-10-PLAN-02 receiver distance"
min = 85.0
max = 85.0

[params.receiver_criterion_dba]
type = "float"
unit = "dBA"
description = "RECEIVER-10-PLAN-02 receiver criterion"
min = 55.0
max = 55.0

[outputs.bod_removed_kg_d]
description = "BOD removed by the aeration case"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nitrogen_removed_kg_d]
description = "Nitrogen removed by the aeration case"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.oxygen_demand_kg_d]
description = "Total process oxygen demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_airflow_m3_min]
description = "Required aeration airflow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.blower_oxygen_capacity_margin_kg_d]
description = "Selected blower oxygen capacity minus oxygen demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.blower_input_power_kw]
description = "Blower input power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.motor_margin_kw]
description = "Selected motor rating minus blower input power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.combined_source_spl_dba]
description = "Log-summed source sound level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.receiver_spl_dba]
description = "Receiver sound level after distance loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.acoustic_margin_db]
description = "Receiver criterion minus receiver sound level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when oxygen, motor, and acoustic margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
